run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum value for integer n using dynamic programming with divisions by 2, 3, 4, and 5
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in test harness with 10 parameter sets
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which builds a DP table choosing max between i and the sum of res[i/2], res[i/3], res[i/4], res[i/5]
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use memoization or recursion instead of the iterative bottom-up DP approach
review_f_gold: review f_gold for correctness and edge cases when n is 0 or 1
